change: Add a Rising or falling mode to the quotient rule workshop

mutations.name: the top is taken the wrong way round
the slope of x² forgets its 2
the sign is read off the bottom as well as the top
dy/dx is divided by g once, not g²
mutations.find: slope(i){ const g=this.parts(i).g; return this.frac(this.top(i), g*g); },
mutations.replace: slope(i){ const g=this.parts(i).g; return this.frac(this.top(i), g); },

mutations.name: a bottom below 0 is told as above it
a tug of war is counted when only one side pulls
y is drawn before the round is right
the tangent is drawn at the left end of the pane
a call still moves once the round is right
